name: TWITTER 骓特 X7 high configuration
why_interesting: The regional X7 store lists five drivetrain configurations. The three retained mainland prices remain separate until their selected builds are proven.

facts.listing_identity: TWITTER / 骓特 X7 carbon aero road-bike family
facts.complete_weight: TWITTER Bikes USA, which identifies itself as the U.S. distributor, claims from 7.6 kg. The current global/Canada builder default is 7.6 kg with ES7000 wireless 1×14 at XS/46 cm; the page also gives generic from 7.5 kg and from 7.6 kg claims. No weighing method is stated and none of these values is tied to the retained high configuration.
facts.drivetrain_options: Regional options: SENTYEH ES7000 1x14 wireless; Shimano 105 R7120 2x12; Shimano 105 R7170 Di2 2x12; WheelTop EDS TX 2x12 wireless; WheelTop EVO TX 2x12 wireless
facts.frame_and_fit: T1000/T1100/T1K carbon, sizes 46/49/51/53/56, T47x24 bottom bracket
facts.frame_material: Carbon X7 family construction; the regional distributor lists T1000/T1100/T1K grades and T1K fork, but does not bind those grades to the retained mainland build. Exact build lay-up remains unresolved.
facts.identity_source: Exact X7 product page from TWITTER Bikes USA, which identifies itself as the U.S. distributor; this supports family identity, not a mainland SKU or seller.
facts.stiffness_evidence_status: No exact X7 frame-stiffness magnitude or reproducible test protocol found after 50-area exact-model sweep
